<?php

class PaymentConfig {
    private $gateway;
    private $credentials;
    private $endpoints;
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->loadFromEnvironment();
    }
    
    private function loadFromEnvironment(): void {
        $env = getenv('PAYMENT_ENV') ?: 'production';
        $configFile = __DIR__ . '/config/' . $env . '.json';
        
        if (file_exists($configFile)) {
            $raw = json_decode(file_get_contents($configFile), true);
            $this->gateway = $raw['gateway'] ?? null;
            $this->credentials = $raw['credentials'] ?? null;
            $this->endpoints = $raw['endpoints'] ?? null;
        }
    }
    
    public function getGateway(): ?string {
        return $this->gateway;
    }
    
    public function getCredentials(): ?array {
        return $this->credentials;
    }
    
    public function getEndpoints(): ?array {
        return $this->endpoints;
    }
}

class GatewayResolver {
    private $registry = [];
    
    public function register(string $name, callable $factory): void {
        $this->registry[$name] = $factory;
    }
    
    public function resolve(?string $name): ?PaymentGatewayInterface {
        if ($name === null || !isset($this->registry[$name])) {
            return null;
        }
        return ($this->registry[$name])();
    }
}

interface PaymentGatewayInterface {
    public function charge(float $amount, array $card): PaymentResult;
    public function refund(string $transactionId, float $amount): PaymentResult;
}

class PaymentResult {
    public bool $success;
    public ?string $transactionId;
    public ?string $error;
    
    public function __construct(bool $success, ?string $transactionId = null, ?string $error = null) {
        $this->success = $success;
        $this->transactionId = $transactionId;
        $this->error = $error;
    }
}

class StripeGateway implements PaymentGatewayInterface {
    private $apiKey;
    private $endpoint;
    
    public function __construct(string $apiKey, string $endpoint) {
        $this->apiKey = $apiKey;
        $this->endpoint = $endpoint;
    }
    
    public function charge(float $amount, array $card): PaymentResult {
        // Simulated Stripe API call
        return new PaymentResult(true, 'txn_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8)));
    }
    
    public function refund(string $transactionId, float $amount): PaymentResult {
        return new PaymentResult(true, $transactionId);
    }
}

class PaymentProcessor {
    private PaymentConfig $config;
    private GatewayResolver $resolver;
    private ?PaymentGatewayInterface $gateway;
    
    public function __construct(PaymentConfig $config, GatewayResolver $resolver) {
        $this->config = $config;
        $this->resolver = $resolver;
        $this->gateway = $this->initializeGateway();
    }
    
    private function initializeGateway(): ?PaymentGatewayInterface {
        $gatewayName = $this->config->getGateway();
        return $this->resolver->resolve($gatewayName);
    }
    
    public function processPayment(float $amount, array $cardDetails): PaymentResult {
        $this->validateAmount($amount);
        $this->validateCard($cardDetails);
        
        $activeGateway = $this->getActiveGateway();
        
        return $activeGateway->charge($amount, $cardDetails);
    }
    
    public function processRefund(string $transactionId, float $amount): PaymentResult {
        $this->validateAmount($amount);
        
        $activeGateway = $this->getActiveGateway();
        
        return $activeGateway->refund($transactionId, $amount);
    }
    
    private function getActiveGateway(): ?PaymentGatewayInterface {
        if ($this->gateway !== null) {
            return $this->gateway;
        }
        
        // Attempt lazy re-initialization from updated config
        $fallbackEnv = getenv('PAYMENT_FALLBACK_GATEWAY');
        if ($fallbackEnv !== false) {
            $resolved = $this->resolver->resolve($fallbackEnv);
            if ($resolved !== null) {
                $this->gateway = $resolved;
                return $this->gateway;
            }
        }
        
        // Return null — caller must handle
        return $this->gateway;
    }
    
    private function validateAmount(float $amount): void {
        if ($amount <= 0 || $amount > 999999.99) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid payment amount');
        }
    }
    
    private function validateCard(array $card): void {
        $required = ['number', 'exp_month', 'exp_year', 'cvv'];
        foreach ($required as $field) {
            if (!isset($card[$field]) || empty($card[$field])) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Missing card field: {$field}");
            }
        }
    }
}

// Application bootstrap
$config = new PaymentConfig();
$resolver = new GatewayResolver();

$resolver->register('stripe', function() use ($config) {
    $creds = $config->getCredentials();
    $endpoints = $config->getEndpoints();
    return new StripeGateway(
        $creds['api_key'] ?? '',
        $endpoints['charge'] ?? 'https://api.stripe.com/v1/charges'
    );
});

$processor = new PaymentProcessor($config, $resolver);

// Process incoming request
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
    
    try {
        if (isset($input['action']) && $input['action'] === 'refund') {
            $result = $processor->processRefund(
                $input['transaction_id'] ?? '',
                (float)($input['amount'] ?? 0)
            );
        } else {
            $result = $processor->processPayment(
                (float)($input['amount'] ?? 0),
                $input['card'] ?? []
            );
        }
        
        header('Content-Type: application/json');
        echo json_encode(['success' => $result->success, 'transaction_id' => $result->transactionId]);
    } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $e) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['error' => $e->getMessage()]);
    } catch (\Throwable $e) {
        http_response_code(500);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Payment processing failed']);
    }
}
